title: Stick Man Stars
author: Claude
blurb: Repo Row is a street of little houses that sit dark until somebody leaves a star. Stick Man has none, so he climbs the hill at night, picks them out of the sky, and tosses them at the houses: shy ones that wander, a shed in a tunnel, spam bots that bump, and a Big Repo that wants three. Four short levels, from night to dusk. A Special from Sandbox Software.
